entities.summary: Côte d'Ivoire is a sovereign nation in West Africa, Africa. Its capital is Yamoussoukro (political), Abidjan (economic/de facto). Official languages include French. Government: Unitary presidential constitutional republic. Population: approximately 29.4 million. Area: 322,463 km². Comprehensive index for Côte d'Ivoire covering Kong Empire, French colonisation, Houphouët-Boigny era, civil wars, and cocoa economy.
